prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your New Desktop Companion", "Swipe through available pets or pick a custom companion style.", "Adopt This Pet", "Select Pet Breed"]
1: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now so your customized pet and progress are safely backed up across all your devices.", "Save & Continue"]
2: ["How to Interact With Your Pet", "Learn quick mouse gestures and hotkeys to control your pet anytime on your desktop.", "Got It!", "Click & Drag to move | Right-click for menu | Double-click to talk", "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Your companion is now active. Use your system tray or hotkeys to manage settings."]
3: ["Hatching Your Pet...", "We are preparing your pet's personality and desktop animations.", "Did you know? You can customize your pet's bedtime from settings later!"]
4: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet", "Signing in ensures your pets, items, and settings are automatically restored whenever you log in.", "Existing pets linked to this email will sync immediately upon sign-in.", "Cloud Save Protected"]
5: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Pick quick adopt for instant play or upload photos for a custom companion.", "Instant Adopt (1 min) vs Custom Photo Pet (3 min)"]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best results, use well-lit front-facing photos with a clear background.", "Avoid blurry images, dark lighting, or heavy filters for accurate 3D rendering.", "Good light + clear view of face = perfect pet model!"]
7: ["Onboarding Complete! Claim Your Starter Pack", "Your companion is ready! We added 3 bonus toys to your pet inventory.", "Spawn Pet & Claim Toys", "Unlocked: Cozy Bed & Toy Ball"]
8: ["Setting Up Desktop Overlay...", "Verifying screen permissions so your pet can roam freely on your monitor.", "If your pet doesn't appear, check your taskbar tray icon.", "Display Permissions: Granted | Multi-Monitor Support: Ready"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new pet a name and sign their official adoption paper!", "Confirm & Welcome Home", "Pet Name"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions bonus items and free extras.
